title: Vampire Vape Caramel Crunch 10ml E-Liquid
description: Surprise and delight your sweet toothed taste buds with the Caramel Crunch Vampire Vape 10ml E-Liquid. This expertly crafted blend offers a deeply comforting and indulgent vaping experience that can delight dessert lovers to the core. With each decadent puff you can savour the luscious fusion of creamy toffee and a velvety, light, nutty butterscotch. So, whether you're seeking a moment of pure indulgence or a sweet treat to satisfy your cravings. Caramel Crunch by Vampire Vape could be the perfect choice for your vaping needs. Each bottle of this Vampire Vape Caramel Crunch offers a balanced blend of PG (Propylene Glycol) and VG (Vegetable Glycerin). Ensuring that it can deliver maximum flavour and satisfying clouds. Please note: that the specific PG/VG ratio varies depending on the nicotine strength in each bottle of nicotine E Liquid. For the 3mg nicotine strength, the E-Liquid has a 50VG/50PG ratio. Whilst the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg nicotine strengths contain a 40VG/60PG ratio. Caramel Crunch by Vampire Vape is a versatile blend that can be used with most vape devices to deliver a satisfying vaping experience. Making it ideal for use with low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits, and pod kits. If you love this 10ml bottle of Vampire Vape juice, why not explore their other equally delicious popular flavours. Their iconic E-Liquid collection offers a broad range to choose from to suit a variety of vaping needs. So whether you're looking for your next seriously smooth nicotine salt Vampire Vape Nic Salt for a perfectly smooth throat hit. Or inspired to make your own vape juice blends with their Vampire Vape Flavour Concentrates. You're sure to find a vape juice flavour and type that suits your vaping needs.
